entries.label: SENSE_EVIL
entries.body:
We sense... something... something ancient... a sickly smell... a chilling wind.
My ancestors scream from within their chambers in my mind
but I cannot understand their words.
This feeling... a memory? It sickens us, and for the first time in our lives
for the first time in generations
We fear.
entries.source:

We fear.
entries.translation:
我們感覺到……某種東 西……古老的東西…… 病態的氣味……刺骨寒風。
祖先在我心靈深處的密室裡 尖叫
但我聽不懂他們的話。
這種感覺……一段記憶？ 它令我們作嘔， 而我們生平第一次
數個世代以來第一次
感到了恐懼。

entries.label: HELLO_AND_DIE_1
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
We cleanse our destiny.
You will soon die.
Make whatever rituals are necessary for your species.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
We cleanse our destiny.
You will soon die.
Make whatever rituals are necessary for your species.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
我們淨化自己的命運。
你很快就會死。
完成你們物種所需的一切儀 式。

entries.label: HELLO_AND_DIE_2
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Your presence here is premature.
We fight the Kzer-Za for supremacy of Doctrine
and possession of the Sa-Matra.
When the battle is won, our task is simple.
We cleanse. You are the filth.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.

entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
你此刻出現，為時過早。
我們正在與克澤爾扎爭奪教 義的主導地位
以及薩馬特拉的所有權。
勝負決定後，我們的任務很 簡單。
我們負責淨化。 你就是污穢。

entries.label: HELLO_AND_DIE_3
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
You have evaded our attempts to cleanse.
You are no longer filth. You are a threat.
Threats deserve greater attention than filth.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
You have evaded our attempts to cleanse.
You are no longer filth. You are a threat.
Threats deserve greater attention than filth.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
你一再逃過我們的淨化。
你不再只是污穢。 你是威脅。
威脅值得比污穢受到更多關 注。

entries.label: HELLO_AND_DIE_4
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Our nature, the fulfillment of our fate
requires your destruction.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Our nature, the fulfillment of our fate
requires your destruction.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
我們的本性，以及命運的實 現
都要求你遭到毀滅。

entries.label: HELLO_SAMATRA
entries.body:
FILTH! YOU may NOT approach the Sa-Matra.
Your death was inevitable, but now it is also imminent.
entries.source:
FILTH! YOU may NOT approach the Sa-Matra.
Your death was inevitable, but now it is also imminent.
entries.translation:
污穢！「你」不得接近薩馬 特拉。
你的死原本就無可避免， 如今更迫在眉睫。

entries.label: WE_KILL_ALL_1
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
We have won the ritual war against our cousins, the Kzer-Za.
Our Doctrine, the Path of Now and Forever, shall be dominant
until the Kzer-Za win such a war.
We now cleanse the Kzer-Za slave-races.
Then we shall take possession of the Sa-Matra and move on
to find new intelligence
new filth to cleanse.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
We have won the ritual war against our cousins, the Kzer-Za.
Our Doctrine, the Path of Now and Forever, shall be dominant
until the Kzer-Za win such a war.
We now cleanse the Kzer-Za slave-races.
Then we shall take possession of the Sa-Matra and move on
to find new intelligence
new filth to cleanse.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
我們已在對抗同族克澤爾扎 的儀式戰爭中獲勝。
我們的教義——永恆現世之 道——將居於主導
直到克澤爾扎贏得同樣的戰 爭。
現在，我們要淨化克澤爾扎 的奴隸種族。
接著，我們將取得薩馬特拉 並繼續前進
尋找新的智慧生命
新的污穢，加以淨化。

entries.label: WE_KILL_ALL_2
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Prepare for the cleansing.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Prepare for the cleansing.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿。
準備接受淨化。

entries.body:

Prepare for the cleansing.

We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.

entries.body:

Prepare for the cleansing.
entries.source:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah.
Prepare for the cleansing.
entries.translation:

準備接受淨化。

entries.label: why_kill_all_1
entries.body: What is this madness!? Why are you trying to kill everyone?
entries.source: What is this madness!? Why are you trying to kill everyone?
entries.translation: 這是什麼瘋狂行徑？！ 你們為什麼想殺掉所有人？

entries.label: why_kill_all_2
entries.body: You have no right to continue this genocide!
entries.source: You have no right to continue this genocide!
entries.translation: 你們無權繼續這場種族滅 絕！

entries.label: why_kill_all_3
entries.body: What has made you this way? It is insane!
entries.source: What has made you this way? It is insane!
entries.translation: 究竟是什麼把你們變成這 樣？這太瘋狂了！

entries.label: why_kill_all_4
entries.body: I cannot understand why you do this.
entries.source: I cannot understand why you do this.
entries.translation: 我無法理解你們為何這麼 做。

entries.label: KILL_BECAUSE_1
entries.body:
We do not kill. We cleanse.
Cleansing is necessary to ensure our eternal freedom and security.
Indeed, you fail to understand: there is no death.
Only termination and rebirth.
Each termination brings around the new chance
the possibility to be born an Ur-Quan.
We merely present this opportunity, make it available to all.
entries.source:
We do not kill. We cleanse.

entries.translation:
我們不殺戮。我們淨化。
淨化是確保我族永恆自由與 安全的必要手段。
確實，你未能理解： 死亡並不存在。
只有終止與重生。
每一次終止都會帶來新的機 會
一個投生為烏爾關的可能。
我們只不過將這份機會呈現 出來，提供給所有生命。

entries.label: KILL_BECAUSE_2
entries.body:
Our Path of Now and Forever is self-justifying, it needs no confirmation.
We cleanse. That is all. There is no more.
entries.source:
Our Path of Now and Forever is self-justifying, it needs no confirmation.
We cleanse. That is all. There is no more.
entries.translation:
我們的永恆現世之道本身即 為正當，無須任何證明。
我們淨化。僅此而已。 再無其他。

entries.label: KILL_BECAUSE_3
entries.body:
You have not asked properly.
If you do not ask properly, we will not discuss this matter.
Instead, we cleanse.
entries.source:
You have not asked properly.
If you do not ask properly, we will not discuss this matter.
Instead, we cleanse.
entries.translation:
你的提問方式不正確。
若不以正確方式提問， 我們便不會討論此事。
我們只會淨化。

entries.label: KILL_BECAUSE_4
entries.body: Your understanding is not necessary.
entries.source: Your understanding is not necessary.
entries.translation: 你的理解並非必要。

entries.label: please_dont_kill_1
entries.body: Please, for the love of reason! Stop this madness!
entries.source: Please, for the love of reason! Stop this madness!
entries.translation: 拜託，看在理性的分上！ 停止這場瘋狂行徑！

entries.label: WILL_KILL_1
entries.body: We have listened. We are unmoved. The cleansing will proceed.
entries.source: We have listened. We are unmoved. The cleansing will proceed.
entries.translation: 我們聽見了。我們不為所 動。淨化將繼續進行。

entries.label: please_dont_kill_2
entries.body: Your logic is faulty. How can you have security in the midst of an endless war?
entries.source: Your logic is faulty. How can you have security in the midst of an endless war?
entries.translation: 你們的邏輯有誤。 身陷無盡戰爭， 如何還能擁有安全？

entries.label: WILL_KILL_2
entries.body:
The cleansing ensures our freedom and security.
Threats to this freedom and security are confined to non-Ur-Quan intelligent life forms.
To preserve our freedom and security, we cleanse such threats.
entries.source:
The cleansing ensures our freedom and security.
Threats to this freedom and security are confined to non-Ur-Quan intelligent life forms.
To preserve our freedom and security, we cleanse such threats.
entries.translation:
淨化確保了我們的自由與安 全。
所有非烏爾關智慧生命， 都是對這份自由與安全的威 脅。
為了保存自由與安全， 我們淨化此類威脅。

entries.label: please_dont_kill_3
entries.body: Stop killing people! You have to stop!
entries.source: Stop killing people! You have to stop!
entries.translation: 別再殺人了！你們必須停 手！

entries.label: WILL_KILL_3
entries.body:
We do not have to stop. No one can make us stop except the Kzer-Za
and they have lost the war. Our doctrine is now dominant.
The cleansing will continue.
entries.source:
We do not have to stop. No one can make us stop except the Kzer-Za
and they have lost the war. Our doctrine is now dominant.
The cleansing will continue.
entries.translation:
我們不必停手。 除克澤爾扎以外， 無人能迫使我們停手
而他們已輸掉戰爭。 如今由我們的教義主導。
淨化將繼續。

entries.label: please_dont_kill_4
entries.body: Is there anything we can do to make you stop the killing?
entries.source: Is there anything we can do to make you stop the killing?
entries.translation: 我們能做些什麼， 讓你們停止殺戮？

entries.label: WILL_KILL_4
entries.body:
If you eliminate all non-Ur-Quan sentient races, including yourselves
then we will stop.
We have made this offer before. No one accepts.
So we cleanse.
entries.source:
If you eliminate all non-Ur-Quan sentient races, including yourselves
then we will stop.
We have made this offer before. No one accepts.
So we cleanse.
entries.translation:
若你消滅所有非烏爾關智慧 種族，包括你們自己
我們就會停手。
我們以前提出過這項條件。 從未有人接受。
所以，我們淨化。

entries.label: bye_frenzy_1
entries.body: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.source: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.translation: 我們現在要離開。 無論如何，我們會阻止你 們。

entries.label: bye_frenzy_2
entries.body: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.source: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.translation: 我們現在要離開。 無論如何，我們會阻止你 們。

entries.label: bye_frenzy_3
entries.body: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.source: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.translation: 我們現在要離開。 無論如何，我們會阻止你 們。

entries.label: bye_frenzy_4
entries.body: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.source: We leave now. We will stop you, somehow.
entries.translation: 我們現在要離開。 無論如何，我們會阻止你 們。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_FRENZY_1
entries.body:
You may not leave. You are filth.
You shall be cleansed.
entries.source:
You may not leave. You are filth.
You shall be cleansed.
entries.translation:
你不得離開。你是污穢。
你將接受淨化。

entries.label: threat_1
entries.body: If you attack us, we will destroy you. Don't even try it.
entries.source: If you attack us, we will destroy you. Don't even try it.
entries.translation: 你們若攻擊，我們就會摧毀 你們。最好連試都別試。

entries.label: RESISTANCE_IS_USELESS_1
entries.body:
Over five thousand races have made such a claim.
We survived. They did not.
Nor shall you.
entries.source:
Over five thousand races have made such a claim.
We survived. They did not.
Nor shall you.
entries.translation:
已有超過五千個種族說過同 樣的話。
我們存續至今。他們沒有。
你們也不會。

entries.label: threat_2
entries.body: Resistance is useless. Our victory is inevitable!
entries.source: Resistance is useless. Our victory is inevitable!
entries.translation: 抵抗毫無用處。 我們必將勝利！

entries.label: RESISTANCE_IS_USELESS_2
entries.body: It is not.
entries.source: It is not.
entries.translation: 並非如此。

entries.label: threat_3
entries.body: You have attacked us before, and we survived! You cannot defeat us. Submit!
entries.source: You have attacked us before, and we survived! You cannot defeat us. Submit!
entries.translation: 你們以前攻擊過我們， 而我們活下來了！ 你們無法擊敗我們。投降！

entries.label: RESISTANCE_IS_USELESS_3
entries.body: We did. You did. Yes we can. No.
entries.source: We did. You did. Yes we can. No.
entries.translation: 我們攻擊過。你們活下來 了。我們能擊敗你們。 不會投降。

entries.label: threat_4
entries.body: Surrender or die.
entries.source: Surrender or die.
entries.translation: 投降，否則受死。

entries.label: RESISTANCE_IS_USELESS_4
entries.body:
Our counter to your statement is simpler
just `die'.
entries.source:
Our counter to your statement is simpler
just `die'.
entries.translation:
我們的回答更簡單
只有「死」。

entries.label: key_phrase
entries.body: Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.source: Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.translation: 住手！你們這樣對待我們是 錯的！為什麼要這麼做？

entries.label: RESPONSE_TO_KEY_PHRASE
entries.body:
THE WORDS!... the Words... the words
Alien, you have spoken the Words. You have spoken them rightly.
We will explain to you about the Dnyarri, our slavemasters
the Taalo, our only friends... whom we exterminated
and our reasons why we cleanse the galaxy of all other sentient life.
We have explained this before, over twenty thousand years ago.
Your words, `Why do you do this thing?' echo that ancient plea.
You see, alien, we were a proud and mighty race, who were cruelly enslaved.
For thousands of years, we had no free will.
We were nothing more than tools.
Never again will anyone enslave our people.
We cleanse the galaxy of such threats.

entries.translation:
那些話！……那些話…… 那些話
外星人，你說出了那些話。 你正確地說出了它們。
我們會向你解釋迪納里—— 我們昔日的奴隸主
塔洛——我們唯一的朋 友……卻被我們滅絕
以及為何要淨化銀河中所有 其他智慧生命。
兩萬多年前，我們曾解釋過 一次。
你的話——「為什麼要這麼 做？」——與那聲古老哀求 如出一轍。
你要明白，外星人， 我們曾是驕傲強大的種族， 卻遭到殘酷奴役。
數千年間，我們沒有自由意 志。
我們不過是工具。
再也不會有任何人奴役我 族。
我們淨化銀河中的此類威 脅。

entries.label: why_do_you_destroy
entries.body: Kohr-Ah, tell us about yourselves.
entries.source: Kohr-Ah, tell us about yourselves.
entries.translation: 克爾阿，告訴我們你們的 事。

entries.label: WE_WERE_SLAVES
entries.body:
We evolved on a hostile world, the descendants of solitary hunters.
In a world where one species is the dominant killer
one's only threat is one's brother, one's sister, anyone of one's species.
Civilization did not come easily to us, we earned it.
We mastered our hatreds and murderous desires to form a mighty culture.
In those ancient days, there was no Kohr-Ah or Kzer-Za, only the Ur-Quan.
We explored our world, and then the space beyond.
Here we met the six races of the Sentient Milieu
here we met the Taalo... the only species we ever called `friend'.
Our association with the Taalo and the Milieu lasted for three thousand years.
We, the Ur-Quan who could not tolerate the presence of others
became the Milieu's scouts, their solitary explorers.

entries.translation:
我們在一個充滿敵意的世界 演化，是獨行獵手的後裔。
在一個由單一物種主宰殺戮 的世界
唯一的威脅便是自己的兄 弟、姊妹，以及所有同類。
文明並未輕易降臨。 我們靠自己贏得了它。
我們駕馭仇恨與殺戮欲望， 建立起強盛文化。
在那遠古年代， 沒有克爾阿，也沒有克澤爾 扎，只有烏爾關。
我們探索自己的世界， 接著探索世界以外的太空。
我們在那裡遇見智慧共同體 的六個種族
也在那裡遇見塔洛…… 唯一曾被我們稱為「朋友」 的物種。
我們與塔洛及共同體的交往 維持了三千年。
我們烏爾關原本無法容忍其 他生命出現在身邊
卻成為共同體的偵察員， 駕駛偵察艦獨自探索。

entries.label: relationship_with_urquan
entries.body: Who were the Taalo?
entries.source: Who were the Taalo?
entries.translation: 塔洛是什麼人？

entries.label: WE_ARE_URQUAN_TOO
entries.body:
Of all the species we have met, only the Taalo did not trigger our instinctive territoriality.
They were the only people we could stand with, or talk to, without the hunter inside us screaming
`Kill the interloper! Rip out its life!'
We believe that the same factors that made the Taalo non-threatening to us
their unusual rock-like biology
also gave the Taalo natural immunity to the Dnyarri's psychic compulsion.
The Dnyarri would not permit this.
After they had conquered all six of the other races in the Milieu
they commanded us to attack the Taalo and we did.
The Taalo would not fight back... they died.

entries.translation:
在我們遇過的一切物種中， 只有塔洛不會觸發我們本能 的領域意識。
他們是唯一能讓我們站在身 旁、與之交談， 而不使內在獵手尖叫的民族
「殺死入侵者！ 扯出他的生命！」
我們相信，塔洛之所以不會 對我們構成威脅
是因為他們有著不尋常、 近似岩石的生物構造
而這也使塔洛天生免疫迪納 里的心靈強迫。
迪納里不容許此事。
征服共同體另外六個種族後
他們命令我們攻擊塔洛， 而我們服從了。
塔洛沒有還手…… 他們死了。

entries.label: what_about_culture
entries.body: Who or what are the Dnyarri?
entries.source: Who or what are the Dnyarri?
entries.translation: 迪納里是誰，或是什麼東 西？

entries.label: BONE_GARDENS
entries.body:
It was on a routine planetfall that one of our Milieu scoutships first met the Dnyarri
the creatures you know as our Talking Pets.
But the Dnyarri were different then.
They were evilly intelligent and wielded psychic powers to control the minds of others.
They wanted to rule the universe. We had no choice but to give it to them.
Our Ur-Quan scoutships transported the Dnyarri through the Milieu.
The war for dominance, such as it was, was quick and bloodless.
Within weeks, the Dnyarri controlled all races but one... the Taalo.

entries.translation:
我方一艘共同體偵察艦在例 行登陸行星時， 首次遇見迪納里
也就是你們所知、 被我們當作會說話的寵物之 生物。
但當時的迪納里並不一樣。
他們邪惡而聰明， 能運用心靈力量控制他人思 想。
他們想統治宇宙。 我們別無選擇， 只能將宇宙交給他們。
烏爾關偵察艦載著迪納里穿 梭共同體各地。
那場所謂的支配權之戰迅速 而不流血。
短短數週內，迪納里便控制 了除一族以外的所有種 族……塔洛。

entries.label: how_leave_me_alone
entries.body: How did you defeat the Dnyarri?
entries.source: How did you defeat the Dnyarri?
entries.translation: 你們是如何擊敗迪納里的？

entries.label: YOU_DIE
entries.body:
For thousands of years, we were unthinking slaves to the Dnyarri.
Like the five other surviving races of the old Milieu, we had no choice.
The Dnyarri's compulsion was too strong to resist.
But the Dnyarri were not satisfied with their slave races.
The Yuli and the Drall were inferior, they decided
and so they instructed us to incinerate their worlds, and we did.
The Dnyarri had a special liking for us Ur-Quan
so they began to tinker with our genes... to improve us, their favored slaves.
Their efforts split the Ur-Quan into two sub-races
The Green Ur-Quan, effete scientists and bureaucrats
and the Black Ur-Quan, their Effectuators, the builders, the fighters, the doers.
The Kohr-Ah are the Black Ur-Quan. The Kzer-Za are the Green.
I grow tired of talking, alien, and your time grows short.
I will continue for but a moment longer.
When we discovered that intense pain could block the Dnyarri's mental powers
we were able to destroy them, but it took years.
Can you imagine, alien, what it must have been like to wear an Excruciator?
To live in endless screaming pain for months on end? No you cannot.

entries.translation:
數千年間，我們都是迪納里 沒有思想的奴隸。
就像舊共同體另外五個倖存 種族，我們別無選擇。
迪納里的強迫力量過於強 大，無法抵抗。
但迪納里並不滿足於自己擁 有的奴隸種族。
他們認為尤利與德拉爾低劣 不堪
於是命令我們焚盡其世界， 而我們服從了。
迪納里格外偏愛我們烏爾關
因此開始改造我們的基 因……改善他們最鍾愛的奴 隸。
他們的實驗將烏爾關分裂成 兩個亞種
綠色烏爾關——柔弱的科學 家與官僚
黑色烏爾關——他們的執行 者、建造者、戰士與實幹 者。
克爾阿是黑色烏爾關。 克澤爾扎則是綠色。
我厭倦談話了，外星人， 你剩下的時間也越來越短。
我只會再繼續片刻。
當我們發現劇烈痛苦可以阻 斷迪納里的心靈力量
就得以摧毀他們， 但這花了許多年。
外星人，你能想像戴著一具 苦刑器是什麼感覺嗎？
連續數月，活在永無止境、 令人尖叫的痛苦中？ 你不能。

entries.label: guess_thats_all
entries.body: I guess that's it. Thanks for the info. We'll just leave now.
entries.source: I guess that's it. Thanks for the info. We'll just leave now.
entries.translation: 我想就這些了。 謝謝你提供資訊。 我們現在就離開。

entries.label: THEN_DIE
entries.body:
No, it is not. There is more you must hear.
When the war was over, the great Kohr-Ah rose from our ranks
and declared the Path of Now and Forever. We would cleanse the galaxy.
No one would ever threaten the Ur-Quan this way again.
We had cleansed one of the three remaining Milieu races and were in orbit around a second's homeworld.
From the surface came a plea... identical to the words you spoke a few moments ago.
The one-eyed creatures, the Mael-Num, asked so simply, so clearly
that we felt compelled to explain. While we did so, the Kzer-Za appeared.
They would not permit us to destroy, they said. Enslave, yes. Imprison, yes. But never destroy.
The moment was tense. Someone opened fire. The first Doctrinal War had begun.
While we fought, the Mael-Num escaped. We never found them again. 
When our battle was done, we, the Kohr-Ah, were defeated
however, the Kzer-Za let us go. We were exiled.
We travelled through space, rebuilt the strength of our battle fleets
and continued our plan, to cleanse threats from the galaxy, for all Ur-Quan.
You have heard our words, and perhaps you understand us a bit better.
But now, it is time for us to cleanse you.

entries.translation:
不，還沒說完。 你還必須聽更多。
戰爭結束後，偉大的克爾阿 從我族之中挺身而出
宣告永恆現世之道。 我們將淨化銀河。
再也不會有人以這種方式威 脅烏爾關。
我們已淨化共同體剩下三族 中的一族，並進入第二族母 星的軌道。
地表傳來一聲哀求…… 與你片刻前說出的話完全相 同。
獨眼生物梅爾－努姆的問題 如此簡單、如此清楚
使我們不得不解釋。 就在解釋時，克澤爾扎出現 了。
他們說，不容許我們毀滅。 奴役，可以。囚禁，可以。 但絕不能毀滅。
氣氛緊繃。有人開火。 第一次教義戰爭就此爆發。
我們交戰時，梅爾－努姆逃 走了。此後再也不曾找到他 們。 
戰鬥結束後，我們克爾阿落 敗
然而克澤爾扎放了我們。 我們遭到放逐。
我們穿越太空， 重建戰鬥艦隊的力量
並為所有烏爾關繼續執行計 畫：淨化銀河中的威脅。
你已聽過我們的話， 也許稍微更理解我們。
但現在，該淨化你了。

entries.label: what_are_you_hovering_over
entries.body: What are you hanging over?
entries.source: What are you hanging over?
entries.translation: 你吊在什麼東西上面？

entries.label: BONE_PILE
entries.body:
My trophy bone-pit.
In here is one skeleton from each of the races which I personally exterminated.
I fondle these bones and recall the fine cleansing.
Perhaps your bones will grace this pit momentarily
unless they are accidentally vaporized.
entries.source:
My trophy bone-pit.
In here is one skeleton from each of the races which I personally exterminated.
I fondle these bones and recall the fine cleansing.
Perhaps your bones will grace this pit momentarily
unless they are accidentally vaporized.
entries.translation:
我的戰利品骨坑。
坑裡收著每個被我親手滅絕 之種族的一具骨骸。
我撫摸這些骨頭， 回味精采的淨化。
也許片刻後，你的骨頭就會 為這座坑增添光彩
除非它們不小心被汽化。

entries.label: you_sure_are_creepy
entries.body: You sure are creepy.
entries.source: You sure are creepy.
entries.translation: 你真的很毛骨悚然。

entries.label: YES_CREEPY
entries.body:
Seeing that I represent your imminent death
as well as the termination of your entire species
I think your fear is well justified.
Nonetheless, you require cleansing.
entries.source:
Seeing that I represent your imminent death
as well as the termination of your entire species
I think your fear is well justified.
Nonetheless, you require cleansing.
entries.translation:
既然我代表你迫在眉睫的死 亡
也代表你整個物種的終止
我認為你的恐懼十分合理。
儘管如此，你仍需接受淨 化。

entries.label: stop_that_gross_blinking
entries.body: Stop that gross blinking!
entries.source: Stop that gross blinking!
entries.translation: 別再噁心地眨眼了！

entries.label: DIE_HUMAN
entries.body: The time has come. You require cleansing.
entries.source: The time has come. You require cleansing.
entries.translation: 時刻已到。你需要淨化。

entries.label: plead_1
entries.body: Please don't destroy this ship. We mean you no harm!
entries.source: Please don't destroy this ship. We mean you no harm!
entries.translation: 請別摧毀這艘船。 我們對你們沒有惡意！

entries.label: PLEADING_IS_USELESS_1
entries.body:
In the twenty thousand years of our Mission
we have heard more pleas for mercy than you can possibly imagine.
Civilizations which saw their doom before them called upon their geniuses to calm us
to no avail.
entries.source:
In the twenty thousand years of our Mission
we have heard more pleas for mercy than you can possibly imagine.
Civilizations which saw their doom before them called upon their geniuses to calm us
to no avail.
entries.translation:
我族使命延續的兩萬年間
聽過的求饒遠比你能想像的 更多。
預見末日逼近的文明曾召集 天才，試圖安撫我們
全都徒勞無功。

entries.label: plead_2
entries.body: If you let us go, we'll tell you a big secret!
entries.source: If you let us go, we'll tell you a big secret!
entries.translation: 只要放我們走， 我們就告訴你一個天大的祕 密！

entries.label: PLEADING_IS_USELESS_2
entries.body:
We are self-sufficient. We need nothing. We want nothing
beyond the total destruction of all non-Ur-Quan sentience.
entries.source:
We are self-sufficient. We need nothing. We want nothing
beyond the total destruction of all non-Ur-Quan sentience.
entries.translation:
我們自給自足。 我們一無所需，一無所求
只求徹底毀滅所有非烏爾關 智慧生命。

entries.label: plead_3
entries.body: What if we promise to be your slaves? Will you let us live then?
entries.source: What if we promise to be your slaves? Will you let us live then?
entries.translation: 如果我們答應當你們的奴隸 呢？這樣會讓我們活下來 嗎？

entries.label: PLEADING_IS_USELESS_3
entries.body:
The ignominy of slaving we leave to our Kzer-Za cousins.
We have no need for inferiors as servants.
entries.source:
The ignominy of slaving we leave to our Kzer-Za cousins.
We have no need for inferiors as servants.
entries.translation:
奴役的恥辱，由克澤爾扎同 族承擔。
我們不需要低等生命充當僕 役。

entries.label: plead_4
entries.body: Don't attack us! We are not your enemies!
entries.source: Don't attack us! We are not your enemies!
entries.translation: 別攻擊我們！我們不是你們 的敵人！

entries.label: PLEADING_IS_USELESS_4
entries.body:
You are right.
You are not our enemy.
We have NO enemy
beyond the Kzer-Za, our partners in the eternal conflict.
You are simply... a spore, a seed.
Today you are nothing... insignificant.
But if allowed to bloom and grow someday...
someday, you might represent a threat to our freedom and security.
So we cleanse.

entries.translation:
你說得沒錯。
你不是我們的敵人。
我們「沒有」敵人
除了克澤爾扎——我族在永 恆衝突中的另一方。
你只不過是……一枚孢子， 一顆種子。
今天，你什麼都不是…… 微不足道。
但若任由你在未來開花成 長……
有朝一日，你或許會威脅我 們的自由與安全。
所以，我們淨化。

entries.label: bye
entries.body: I've heard enough of your madness for now. Goodbye.
entries.source: I've heard enough of your madness for now. Goodbye.
entries.translation: 你們的瘋話，我目前已聽夠 了。再會。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE
entries.body:
Before we destroy other thinking beings we share with them this comforting fact
This life of yours... which shall end immediately following this statement
is but one of many lives you will live.
Perhaps, in your next incarnation
you will be born an Ur-Quan.
entries.source:
Before we destroy other thinking beings we share with them this comforting fact
This life of yours... which shall end immediately following this statement
is but one of many lives you will live.
Perhaps, in your next incarnation
you will be born an Ur-Quan.
entries.translation:
在摧毀其他智慧生命前， 我們會與他們分享這項寬慰 人心的事實
你的這一生…… 在這段話結束後便會立即終 結
不過是你將經歷的眾多生命 之一。
或許在下一次轉世
你會投生為烏爾關。

entries.label: GAME_OVER_DUDE
entries.body:
Attention human!
This broadcast is to inform you of your defeat.
We, the Kohr-Ah, have destroyed all the sentient species in this region of space
and now we have eliminated the Starbase orbiting your planet Earth as well.
Your efforts to resist us are futile.
You are defeated!
entries.source:
Attention human!
This broadcast is to inform you of your defeat.
We, the Kohr-Ah, have destroyed all the sentient species in this region of space
and now we have eliminated the Starbase orbiting your planet Earth as well.
Your efforts to resist us are futile.
You are defeated!
entries.translation:
人類注意！
這段廣播是為了通知你已經 戰敗。
我們克爾阿已摧毀這片太空 區域中的所有智慧物種
如今也消滅了環繞你們地球 運行的星際基地。
你們抵抗我們的努力毫無意 義。
你們敗了！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah
The followers of the Path of Now and Forever!
You are filth. We shall cleanse.
You WILL be annigilated... I mean annihigated.. damn!
CUT! CUT! Let's start over!
Hey, mister director... can you PLEASE think of SOME other word besides
agnigilate... I mean, oh what's the use. I give up.

We are the Ur-Quan Kohr-Ah
The followers of the Path of Now and Forever!
You are filth. We shall cleanse.
You WILL be annigilated... I mean annihigated.. damn!
CUT! CUT! Let's start over!
Hey, mister director... can you PLEASE think of SOME other word besides
agnigilate... I mean, oh what's the use. I give up.
entries.translation:
我們是烏爾關克爾阿
永恆現世之道的追隨者！
你是污穢。我們將加以淨 化。
你「必將」被殲泥滅掉…… 我是說殲滅泥掉……可惡！
卡！卡！重來！
嘿，導演先生…… 你能不能「拜託」換個詞， 別再用
殲泥滅……我是說，唉， 有什麼用。我放棄了。
